title: Generic call-to-action notes do not invent a phone-channel requirement
steps: Run run.cmd without a server or model calls.
Verify generic notes on both class pages pass R12, while genuine and mixed phone promises retain their phone-link requirement.
expect: The two notes saying closing call to action: book an assessment no longer fail R12.
A generic CTA phrase in notes or labels, including case and hyphen variants, does not imply a phone call.
Mixed call to action: call +971 wording and genuine phone or ring-us promises still fail without a phone target.
A real phone target satisfies the phone requirement; WhatsApp and direct-message requirements remain unchanged.

tests: R12 generic call-to-action notes on two class pages do not promise a phone channel
R12 generic CTA wording is ignored in notes and labels regardless of case or hyphenation
R12 generic CTA wording does not conceal a real phone promise in the same note or label
R12 real phone promises still pass with a phone target, while WhatsApp and DM requirements remain
